lead.headline: Spain's rail toll reaches 68 as minister blames restart order
lead.dek: Puente says controllers restarted the Renfe train with no speed limit after a signal failure; three days of mourning begin
body: A Renfe high-speed train from Madrid to Seville struck the rear of a stopped Iryo train near Urda in Toledo province on Wednesday morning, killing at least 68 people, the regional government of Castilla-La Mancha said, in Spain's second deadly high-speed collision in nine months.

Transport Minister Oscar Puente said a computer failure knocked out the safety system on a 63-kilometer stretch at 8:30 a.m. and halted every train; the control center then told the Renfe train, carrying 397 people, to restart without speed restrictions while a stop signal was still active, and it hit the Iryo train, carrying 147, at 8:53, AP and CBS News reported. Puente called the order "inexplicable."

The government declared three days of mourning through Saturday, and Adif suspended high-speed service between Madrid and Andalusia. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, who faces an election Nov. 29, called two such crashes in a year "unacceptable"; a January collision on the same line at Adamuz killed 46, Al Jazeera reported. A minute's silence at Madrid's Cibeles Square turned into a protest calling for Puente to resign.

art.caption: A medical helicopter below the Urda crash site, the white Renfe train at left, the red Iryo train at right and a carriage tipped nose-down.
art.credit: Sketched from an Al Jazeera photograph

briefs.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75% to 4% as two officials press for a hike
briefs.summary: The 10-2 vote left the range unchanged a month after the first increase in three years; Gov. Lisa Cook and Cleveland's Beth Hammack dissented for a quarter-point rise.

briefs.headline: Hegseth fires Joint Staff's top planner over alleged leaks
briefs.summary: Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia failed three polygraphs about sharing classified Iran and Ukraine information with reporters, a Pentagon official told CBS News; the case went to DOJ.

briefs.headline: Judge rejects DOJ bid to sideline 20,000 California ballots
briefs.summary: Judge David Carter cited Nevada, where a DOJ list of 15,903 possible noncitizens shrank to 185, all citizens, and told DOJ to indict individuals instead; DOJ filed notice of appeal.

briefs.headline: Hackers post names and addresses of 40,000 DHS employees
briefs.summary: A group calling itself Department of Peace says it breached DHS's sign-on system; more than 21,000 records identify CBP staff and about 10,000 ICE, NPR reported.

briefs.headline: Likud alleges 'stolen' vote as Israel's count nears 90%
briefs.summary: Netanyahu's party says the election was 'stolen by Arab parties' and is passing evidence to police; his bloc has 53 seats, Eisenkot's 48, with more than 500,000 ballots left.

briefs.headline: Ukraine drones hit Russian plants as Moscow claims 1,214 downed
briefs.summary: Russia's defense ministry said it downed 1,214 drones over 15 regions overnight; monitoring channels reported hits on the Bashkir Soda and Azot chemical plants, Kyiv Post reported.

briefs.headline: Flavio Bolsonaro calls himself Brazil's 'elected president'
briefs.summary: From Florida, the defeated candidate alleged fraud in a post he later edited to 'leader' and said he would oppose Lula from abroad; he is under a corruption investigation.

briefs.headline: North Korea fires about 10 ballistic missiles into the sea
briefs.summary: South Korea's Joint Chiefs said the short-range missiles flew from near Wonsan about 12:30 p.m. Thursday; Japan said they fell outside its exclusive economic zone.

briefs.headline: Chlorine cloud puts South Charleston under hour-long shelter order
briefs.summary: A release at the Solenis plant on MacCorkle Avenue prompted the shelter-in-place about 2 p.m. Wednesday; Metro 911 lifted it at 2:51 p.m., and no injuries were reported.

briefs.headline: NextEra says it fired land agent accused of coercing landowner
briefs.summary: On day three of PSC hearings on the MARL line, a NextEra director said an agent who threatened a landowner with a restraining order was dismissed; testimony resumes at 9 a.m.

briefs.headline: Jurors hear Casto's recorded call on day 2 of murder trial
briefs.summary: Prosecutors in Parkersburg played a call in which Gregory Casto said Cindy Ball Dilo stabbed him and jumped from his vehicle in 2014; a nurse testified she bandaged his shoulders.

briefs.headline: Peak Health enters ACA marketplace as CareSource exits
briefs.summary: The WVU Medicine-backed insurer will sell 2027 plans in 45 counties, Highmark seeks an average 18% increase and out-of-pocket maximums rise to $12,000; enrollment opens Nov. 1.

regional.item: The state cut the Enslow Park Bridge weight limit from 33 to 9 tons over beam section loss, rerouting three Cabell school buses.
Yeager Airport's board advanced a $15M, FAA-funded terminal enabling project Wednesday, with Swope Construction the apparent low bidder.
The Lottery Commission is keeping Parkersburg-based Trans-Allegheny's 172 video lottery machines at 26 sites off until it files financial statements.
The county kennel holds 12 dogs in space built for six, seven of them from a cruelty case, and is seeking adopters and fosters.

away.item: A boiler-room fire forced Mount Anthony Union Middle School to evacuate Oct. 22; the school closed Friday and reopened Monday.

hotspots.item: A Webster County High senior's design won WVDOT's statewide Paint the Plow vote, announced Oct. 20, and the plow will be in service this winter.
A water main break Tuesday night cut service from Roland Avenue south to the Topsail Beach line; a boil advisory ran to 4 p.m. Wednesday.

briefs.headline: Turnout under 50% in B.C. vote draws scrutiny in Prince George
briefs.summary: CKPG reports provincial turnout fell below half of eligible voters for the first time; an expert it quoted said fewer parties on the ballot may have kept voters home.

briefs.headline: Doerkson vows to keep every promise, names finance review panel
briefs.summary: The premier-designate told Global News he is 'really committed to everything that I promised,' including PST relief, and will appoint an independent financial review panel.

briefs.headline: Humpback hit by B.C. Ferries vessel found dead near Grace Islands
briefs.summary: Humpbacks of the Salish Sea matched flipper markings to the whale known as Notcho, struck about 10 days ago; DFO recovered the carcass and is investigating.

briefs.headline: Bank of Canada raises its rate to 2.5%, first hike since 2023
briefs.summary: The quarter-point increase is meant to stop high energy prices spreading, Governor Tiff Macklem said; CPI has run near 3% since April and the next decision is Dec. 9.

briefs.headline: 'Associate member' dropped from Canada-EU summit draft
briefs.summary: CTV News confirmed the term is out of the draft statement after German-led objections as Carney hosts von der Leyen and Costa in Montreal through Friday.

briefs.headline: LA firestorm smoke carried lead at 80 times background
briefs.summary: Caltech's hourly PM2.5 chemistry, in Science Advances, shows about 7 million people breathed lead at 80 times normal for 24 hours at the Eaton Fire's peak.

briefs.headline: Achilles injections no better than sham in BMJ trial
briefs.summary: A 192-patient Melbourne trial found high-volume injections, with or without corticosteroid, no better than a sham injection for Achilles tendinopathy at 12 months.

briefs.headline: Sonar survey counts 2.8 million eels on one seamount
briefs.summary: CSIRO acoustic surveys of Patience Seamount off Tasmania found spawning swarms of basketwork eels weighing about 3,550 tonnes, Royal Society Open Science reports.

briefs.headline: NASA's Lucy becomes first spacecraft in Jupiter's Trojans
briefs.summary: Five years after launch and 2.2 billion miles out, Lucy entered the Trojan asteroid swarm; its first flyby there, of Eurybates, comes Aug. 11, 2027.

briefs.headline: Microsoft posts record $45.2B capex as Azure grows 48%
briefs.summary: Fiscal first-quarter revenue hit $92.3B and Azure $33.2B, the first dollar figure the company has disclosed; $10B of revenue came from OpenAI, TechCrunch reported.

briefs.headline: Norwegian outlets seek injunction against Meta's AI terms
briefs.summary: Ten media companies including NRK and Schibsted asked the Oslo District Court to block terms letting Meta train on their content; Meta delayed the rollout to Nov. 20.

briefs.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon scores 59 on independent index, up from 50
briefs.summary: Artificial Analysis rates Google DeepMind's new model nine points above its two-week-old Argon; the same evaluator's hallucination rate rose to 11% from 4%, The Decoder reported.

weather_ear: Thursday's forecast arrives at 7:15 from the weather desk.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster carries no regional line today; the Kyushu basho (tournament) opens Nov. 8 in Fukuoka, 10 days out.
